title: Unique Friend | Mingyi Chuanshi: Medical-Training SaaS Across 300+ Counties
summary: Primary-care clinicians are the “gatekeepers” of public health — yet talent shortages, lower average credentials, and thin continuing education persist. NHSC guidance keeps pushing upskilling.
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Insight / Unique Friend · March 27, 2023

Primary-care clinicians are the “gatekeepers” of public health — yet talent shortages, lower average credentials, and thin continuing education persist. NHSC guidance keeps pushing upskilling.

Mingyi Chuanshi (名医传世), founded 2014, sells dedicated SaaS training systems to health commissions and hospitals for grassroots CE. CEO Chen Jin: ~4,000 deputy-chief+ doctors → 7,000+ courses across 36 specialties = moat. Live in 300+ counties; >1M installs; ~700k clinician-sessions/month. Parent Guangdong Yiqun Tech has closed three rounds; seeking Series B — Unique Capital is exclusive FA.

Model. Cold-start via medical associations + pharma/device channels → ~6,000 expert candidates → quality-filter to 4,000. Unlike open med-stream platforms, SaaS is issued by county/hospital with mandatory schedules, self-upload, and anti-cheat “train-while-exam” — hence the forced monthly volume. Four-layer monetization (SaaS license + content + exams + vertical add-ons) detailed in CN. Guangdong / Heilongjiang / Hubei among provinces on the platform.

Unique Friend series stays insight (not partner).

— END —
